description: Geoid grids for converting heights above mean sea level to WGS84 ellipsoidal heights. A grid opens the absolute-MSL gate only when its bytes match the SHA-256 recorded here.

grids.name: EGM96 15-minute geoid undulation grid (WW15MGH.DAC)
grids.source: US National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA), EGM96 WW15MGH.DAC with its INTPTDAC interpolation program
grids.obtainedFrom: github.com/nicolas-van/egm96-universal at commit db359c5fbdef592b8c9c720487dd5316511af042 (the same bytes are embedded in the npm package egm96-universal 1.1.1); NGA's site is not reachable from the build environment
grids.crossCheck: Every one of the 1,038,240 nodes agrees within 5.50 mm with an independent conversion of the same NGA model, us_nga/us_nga_egm96_15.tif of github.com/OSGeo/PROJ-data at commit cdab44864a36a9f3c3e90a36637c5d8a86e624c6 (SHA-256 db493027562c9b004d7220fa881f5603adada4e1c5029b933fa7de4547b0e78d): the DAC rounds to whole centimetres. tests/fixtures/geoid/egm96-proj-nodes.json keeps 2,666 of those nodes for the test.
grids.notes: Global. FABDEM elevations refer to EGM2008, whose undulations differ from EGM96 by up to about a metre; heights from FABDEM converted with this grid carry that difference.

grids.name: EGM2008 2.5-minute geoid undulation grid (us_nga_egm08_25.tif)
grids.source: US NGA EGM2008, converted by GeographicLib and distributed in OSGeo PROJ-data us_nga/us_nga_egm08_25.tif at commit cdab44864a36a9f3c3e90a36637c5d8a86e624c6
grids.license: Public domain (US NGA), as stated by PROJ-data us_nga/us_nga_README.txt
grids.decision: 80 MB is too large for the repository. Phase 1 uses the EGM96 grid; a local EGM2008 install verified against this SHA-256 is not implemented yet.
